Subject: Console & API enablement — Streamline Pay kickoff

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick intro today. We'd like to get a hands-on enablement kicked off next week. Our engineering team is split between PST and SGT, so long blocks are hard. Can we do either:

- Option A: 2 x 90-min sessions (Console deep-dive + API walkthrough) on Tue/Wed next week
- Option B: 3 x 60-min focused sessions (Admin flows, API keys & integration, QA/runbook) spread across two days

Preferably late-morning PST (10:00-13:00) so APAC folks can join late afternoon. Target week: Jul 26–30.

Also: our infra lead Tom will need sandbox credentials and a pre-work checklist in advance. I've attached a short internal list of use-cases (training-outline.pdf).

Can you propose times and who would lead each block? We also prefer the sessions recorded.

Best,
Elise Park
Head of Integrations
Streamline Pay

Hi Elise / Tom —

Thanks for the note and the outline. We can absolutely split the work to accommodate time zones. My proposal (short and actionable):

- Session 1 — Console: 60 minutes (admin flows, RBAC, tenant onboarding) — Lead: Tessa Morgan
- Session 2 — API basics: 60 minutes (auth, sample calls, error handling) — Lead: Ben Carter
- Optional Session 3 — Integration runbook + Q&A: 30–45 minutes (recorded) — Lead: me

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jul 27 10:30–11:30 PDT — Console
- Tue Jul 27 12:00–13:00 PDT — API basics
- Wed Jul 28 10:30–11:15 PDT — Runbook & Q&A (optional)

If your engineers prefer 2 x 90-min blocks instead, we can combine Console+API into one deep session. Please confirm which cadence you want and the names/emails of attendees so we can send calendar invites.

I've attached a working agenda (agenda-draft.docx) — happy to tailor it. We'll record all sessions and share the recordings and a short summary runbook afterwards.

Thanks,

olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
